part.name: BBa_26IN6G1D
part.title: LEA14 2.1
part.description: This part encodes a Late Embryogenesis Abundant 14 protein (LEA14) from *Arabidopsis thaliana* gene *At1g01470.1*, which belongs to LEA\_2 subgroup; the wild-type LEA sequence is registered as [BBa\_26LTB0W1](https://registry.igem.org/parts/bba-26ltb0w1). The paper showed overexpression of AtLEA14 enhances salt stress tolerance in *Arabidopsis thaliana*. Therefore, LEA14 is might be the potential gene involved in plant responses to abiotic stress.  In this variant, the first 15 amino acids of the LEA14 coding sequence were codon-optimized, which is predicted to reduce mRNA secondary structure at the 5′ end and thereby enhance translation initiation.
part.source: The LEA gene was designed based on the reference protein sequence (UniProt accession: O03983), doi:10.1110/ps.051579205, 10.1016/j.bbrc.2014.10.136

## **About**

* **Biosafety level:** S1 
* **Target organism:** *Bacillus subtilis* \[168 / WB800] 
*  In this variant, the first 15 codons of the coding sequence were optimized to improve the mRNA secondary structure of the translation start site. 

## **Literature**

The cloned ACC deaminase gene can be expressed in *Escherichia coli*, which enables this bacterium to grow on ACC as its sole nitrogen source. Both *E. coli* and *Pseudomonas* spp. strains transformed with this gene gain the ability to promote root elongation in canola seedlings (Hontzeas et al., 2004).

A soluble recombinant ACC deaminase from *Pseudomonas putida* UW4 was cloned, expressed and purified. It has a molecular weight of 41 kDa and shows selectivity and high activity towards ACC, with a K(M)\=3.4+/-0.2 mM and k(cat)\=146+/-5 min(-1) at pH 8.0 and 22 °C. Activity is optimal at pH 8.0 and declines sharply to essentially nothing below pH 6.5. It tapers off more gradually at higher pH, and activity is lost above pH 10. (Hontzeas et al., 2004).

documentation.title: Application
documentation.value:
This part was designed for the GEMS-Taiwan 2026 iGEM team’s work on a Stress-Responsive Optogenetic Bioreactor for Precision Plant Protection and is used in the construction of composite parts:

* **SamyQ-LEA14 2.1-Histag** ([<u>BBa\_26J0GJGZ</u>](https://registry.igem.org/parts/bba-26j0gjgz)): The Late Embryogenesis Abundant (LEA14) 2.1 protein is fused to the SamyQ signal peptide at the N-terminus and a 6x Histag at the C-terminus.
* **Pveg-EEBD-RBS0-SamyQ-LEA14-Histag 2.1-B0015** ([<u>BBa\_26D5AX7S</u>](https://registry.igem.org/parts/bba-26d5ax7s)): this Protectant Module constitutively expresses potential stress-mitigation proteins and enables evaluation of their secretion and detection, with its constitutive promoter Pveg, RBS EEBD-RBS0, and terminator B0015.
